findings.quote: la civilización tamborilea al borde de la idiocia
findings.sourceQuote: civilization teeters on the brink of idiocy
findings.claim: «Tamborilea» means drums or taps; it does not convey a civilization teetering. It makes the opening confusing rather than sharply comic.
findings.suggestion: Rewrite the opening around a natural image, such as «aparece un aparato nuevo y enseguida parece que la civilización se tambalea al borde de la idiotez». This keeps the exaggerated panic but loses the English verb's exact image; it gains immediate clarity.

findings.claim: The English slang means checking the record or evidence. Literal «recibos» suggests purchase receipts and derails the transition.
findings.suggestion: Use «repasemos los antecedentes» or «veamos qué pasó las otras veces». The receipt joke is lost, while the invitation to test the panic against history becomes natural.

findings.quote: cuándo la IA amplifica el aprendizaje frente a cuando lo corta en seco
findings.sourceQuote: when AI amplifies learning versus short-circuits development
findings.claim: «Lo» points back to «aprendizaje», so the target says AI cuts learning short. The source specifically warns about short-circuiting development.
findings.suggestion: Use «cuándo la IA potencia el aprendizaje y cuándo ataja el desarrollo de sus capacidades». This preserves the two distinct outcomes without forcing the electrical metaphor.

findings.claim: The publication date has been omitted from frontmatter. It is a factual quantity and may affect publication metadata.
The declared hash differs from the current source hash in the supplied packet. Its intended format may differ, so the right replacement requires checking the repository convention.
findings.suggestion: Recompute sourceHash using the repository's expected algorithm and compare it with the supplied current source before publishing.

findings.claim: The plural changes the title's perspective from a singular last thinker to a group. Spanish title capitalization also makes it look translated.
findings.suggestion: Consider «El último en pensar» if the singular is intended; use Spanish sentence capitalization.

findings.quote: ¿Quién se rasga ahora las manos por la pérdida de las habilidades de lectura de mapas?
findings.sourceQuote: Who is hand-wringing about the loss of map-reading skills now?
findings.claim: «Rasgarse las manos» is not the intended Spanish idiom, and «habilidades de lectura de mapas» adds bureaucratic weight to a quick joke.
findings.suggestion: Use «¿Quién se lamenta ahora de que ya no sepamos leer mapas?» It drops the hand gesture but keeps the rhetorical challenge and brisk tone.

findings.quote: No sea que tengamos que recurrir a la relojería analógica.
findings.sourceQuote: Lest we resort to analog timekeeping.
findings.claim: «Relojería» refers chiefly to watches or watchmaking, so the punch line sounds technical by accident.
findings.suggestion: Use «No vaya a ser que tengamos que mirar un reloj de agujas». The concrete object retains the joke about analog timekeeping.

findings.quote: Los años 80 vieron a las calculadoras etiquetadas como «muletas que entorpecerán a una generación».
findings.sourceQuote: The 1980s saw calculators branded as "crutches that will hobble a generation."
findings.claim: «Los años 80 vieron» copies English syntax, and «muletas que entorpecerán» weakens the source's deliberately forceful claim.
findings.suggestion: Use «En los años 80 se llegó a llamar a las calculadoras “muletas que dejarían coja a toda una generación”». The sentence loses the English personification but gains a coherent Spanish metaphor.

sourceConcerns: The source asserts that educators warned about CliffsNotes «In the 1940s». That chronology should be independently fact-checked; the translation should not silently change it.
The source's «Most people under 40 can't read paper maps» is a broad, unsupported generalization. It is inherited by the candidate and should be treated as a source claim.

The source's categorical «it can't replicate human emotional intelligence or creativity» is contestable and may age quickly. Any qualification would require a source edit, not an unannounced translation change.
